evidence: decorative_mascot: In seg3:mid, seg3:end and all of seg4 Data stands waving beside the 'Dad' box. The levers never move and he does nothing to make the hair change. In seg2 he only stands in front of the stands.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg0:end: '1.5% have red hair · World' over an Irish flag. seg1:start: '10% have red hair · Ireland' over the Scottish flag. The readout steps through 1.5%, 10% and 13% while the screen picture lags one value behind.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The jumbotron's flag and the headline readout step out of sync, so each flag shows under the previous or next label. The world value gets a country flag instead of the globe.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Lock the screen picture to the readout: the globe with 1.5% World, then the Saltire with 13% Scotland, and drop the Ireland step the narration never mentions. Show fewer values, so the 1.5% to 13% jump lands as the payoff with the crowd lighting up orange as Data sweeps the spotlight.
